meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把基因序列分析与文献检索自动化成流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理 DNA/蛋白质序列或需要批量查询 NCBI 文献与数据库。
copy.tagline_en: Automate sequence analysis and NCBI lookups in pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely handle DNA/protein sequences or need batch NCBI queries.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 Python 的 Biopython 库完成分子生物学任务：读写常见序列格式、操作 DNA/蛋白序列、访问 NCBI/PubMed、做序列比对/进化树等，并直接产出可运行的代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理生物序列、解析或转换常见生物格式（如 FASTA/GenBank/PDB）、访问 NCBI/PubMed 等生物信息任务时。

say.text: 把这个 FASTA 文件里的每条序列，帮我算出 GC 含量。
在 PubMed 上搜索近五年关于 CRISPR 的综述。
say.note: Claude 会调用 NCBI Entrez 搜索文献。

say.text: 把这些序列做多序列比对，再画一棵进化树。
say.note: Claude 会进行比对并构建进化树。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to use Biopython for molecular biology tasks: read/write common sequence formats, manipulate DNA/protein sequences, access NCBI/PubMed via Entrez, perform sequence alignment and phylogenetics, and produce runnable code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user asks to handle biological sequences, parse/convert common bio file formats (e.g., FASTA/GenBank/PDB), access NCBI/PubMed, or perform related bioinformatics tasks.

say_en.text: Parse this FASTA file and calculate the GC content of each sequence.
say_en.note: Claude reads the file and computes GC content.

say_en.text: Search PubMed for reviews on CRISPR from the last five years.
say_en.note: Claude queries NCBI Entrez for literature.

say_en.text: Align these sequences and draw a phylogenetic tree.
say_en.note: Claude performs alignment and builds a tree.
